data.name: Primary Objective
data.text: Assess net copper balance with daily repeat-dose ALXN1840 treatment (15 mg and 30 mg) in participants with Wilson disease (WD)

data.name: Secondary Objective 1
data.text: Assess change in copper balance in response to ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day during ALXN1840 accumulation and at steady state periods versus the pretreatment baseline in participants with WD

data.name: Secondary Objective 2
data.text: Investigate the effect of ALXN1840 (15 mg/day and 30 mg/day) on the disposition of copper in participants with WD

data.name: Secondary Objective 3
data.text: Investigate the effect of ALXN1840 on the disposition of molybdenum at steady state at 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

data.name: Secondary Objective 4
data.text: Assess steady-state total molybdenum balance as a measure of ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

data.name: Secondary Objective 5
data.text: Assess accumulation of molybdenum with ALXN1840 treatment at 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

data.name: Secondary Objective 6
data.text: Determine the steady-state plasma pharmacokinetic (PK) of total molybdenum and plasma ultrafiltrate (PUF) molybdenum (as surrogate measures of ALXN1840, 15 mg and 30 mg) in participants with WD

data.name: Safety Objective
data.text: Evaluate the safety and tolerability of repeated-dose administration of ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

data.name: Exploratory Objective 1
data.text: Determine dose response of ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day for copper balance in participants with WD

data.name: Exploratory Objective 2
data.text: Determine the effect of treatment duration on copper balance in participants with WD

data.name: Exploratory Objective 3
data.text: Assess the effects of ALXN1840 on ceruloplasmin, ceruloplasmin-bound copper LBC profiles in plasma in participants with WD

data.name: Primary Endpoint
data.text: Mean daily copper balance where copper balance is measured by the calculated difference between copper intake (in food and drink) and copper output (in feces and urine) during ALXN1840 accumulation and steady-state periods for each dose

data.name: Secondary Endpoint 1
data.text: Change in mean daily copper balance as measured by the calculated difference between copper intake (in food and drink) and copper output (in feces and urine) from pretreatment baseline (Days -4 through -1) and ALXN1840 accumulation and steady-state periods for each dose

data.name: Secondary Endpoint 2
data.text: Copper quantified in food, drink, feces, and urine, including plasma total and labile bound copper (LBC) during ALXN1840 accumulation and steady-state periods for each dose

data.name: Secondary Endpoint 3
data.text: Molybdenum quantified in food, drink, feces, and urine, plasma total molybdenum at ALXN1840 steady state

data.name: Secondary Endpoint 4
data.text: Mean daily molybdenum balance as demonstrated through measurement of molybdenum intake (in food, drink and ALXN1840), and molybdenum output (feces and urine) representing ALXN1840 steady state

data.name: Secondary Endpoint 5
data.text: Accumulation of molybdenum as determined by molybdenum balance

data.name: Secondary Endpoint 6
data.text: PK parameters for plasma total and PUF-molybdenum

data.name: Safety Endpoint
data.text: Safety parameters: Treatment emergent adverse events (TEAEs)/serious adverse events (SAEs); Clinical laboratory assessments (serum chemistry, hematology, coagulation, and urinalysis); Physical examinations; Heart rate, intervals (PR, QRS, QT and QTc), and clinically significant electrocardiogram (ECG) findings as determined by triplicate 12-lead ECG; Vital sign assessments (blood pressure and heart rate)

data.name: Exploratory Endpoint 1
data.text: Assess dose response of ALXN1840 on copper balance focusing on copper balance

data.name: Exploratory Endpoint 2
data.text: Determine the effect of time following initiation of ALXN1840 treatment on copper balance

data.name: Exploratory Endpoint 3
data.text: Ceruloplasmin, ceruloplasmin-bound copper, and LBC: Change in ceruloplasmin at Days 1, 8, 25, 29, 36, and Day 39 compared with predose

data.name: Primary Estimand - Net Copper Balance with ALXN1840 15 mg and 30 mg
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with confirmed Wilson disease meeting all eligibility criteria, admitted to a clinical research unit on a copper-controlled diet, previously treated with chelator therapy (discontinued approximately 4 days prior to Day 1) and off zinc therapy for at least 21 days (Full Analysis Set (all enrolled participants who received at least 1 dose of ALXN1840 and have evaluable copper intake/output collections); no comparator arm (single-arm, open-label, within-participant dose comparison)) Summary measure: Descriptive summary statistics (n, arithmetic mean, standard deviation, median, minimum, maximum) of mean daily copper balance by dose level and collection period, with proportion of participants achieving net negative copper balance.

intercurrentEvents.name: Failure to escalate to 30 mg/day due to safety concerns
intercurrentEvents.text: Per adaptive protocol features, participants may remain on ALXN1840 15 mg/day for the duration of the study if the Investigator and/or Alexion judge that escalation to 30 mg/day may place the participant at undue risk; such participants contribute data only to the 15 mg/day dose periods and are summarized according to the dose actually received

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or dose interruption
intercurrentEvents.text: ALXN1840 dose is decreased (to as low as 15 mg every other day) or interrupted because dose modification criteria are met; all available copper balance data are analyzed as observed under the actual dose administered

intercurrentEvents.name: Permanent discontinuation of study intervention or withdrawal from study
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant permanently discontinues ALXN1840 or withdraws before completing all collection periods; observed collection-period data up to discontinuation are included and no imputation is performed

intercurrentEvents.name: Use of prohibited copper-modifying therapy (chelator or zinc)
intercurrentEvents.text: Reinitiation of chelator therapy or zinc as rescue/background therapy during the study would confound copper balance; copper balance is estimated as if the prohibited therapy had not been used (affected collection periods excluded from the primary analysis)

intercurrentEvents.name: Incomplete diet control or incomplete urine/feces collection
intercurrentEvents.text: Non-adherence to the copper-controlled diet (including during the Outpatient Period, Day 9 to Day 23) or incomplete/invalid 24-hour urine or fecal collections; balance is estimated as if complete collection and diet control had occurred, with non-evaluable collection periods excluded

data.treatment: Open-label ALXN1840 (bis-choline tetrathiomolybdate) 15 mg orally once daily for a minimum of 4 weeks, followed by intra-participant dose escalation to ALXN1840 30 mg orally once daily; copper balance assessed during accumulation and steady-state periods for each dose level
data.analysisPopulation: Full Analysis Set (all enrolled participants who received at least 1 dose of ALXN1840 and have evaluable copper intake/output collections); no comparator arm (single-arm, open-label, within-participant dose comparison)
data.variableOfInterest: Mean daily copper balance, calculated as the difference between copper intake (food and drink) and copper output (feces and urine), during ALXN1840 accumulation and steady-state periods for each dose (15 mg/day and 30 mg/day)
data.summaryMeasure: Descriptive summary statistics (n, arithmetic mean, standard deviation, median, minimum, maximum) of mean daily copper balance by dose level and collection period, with proportion of participants achieving net negative copper balance

data.name: Secondary Estimand - Change in Mean Daily Copper Balance from Pretreatment Baseline
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson disease with an evaluable pretreatment baseline copper balance collection (Days -4 through -1, off chelator) and at least one on-treatment collection period (Full Analysis Set (participants with evaluable baseline and at least one post-baseline copper balance assessment); within-participant comparison versus pretreatment baseline) Summary measure: Descriptive summary of within-participant mean change (and percent change) from pretreatment baseline in mean daily copper balance by dose and collection period.

intercurrentEvents.name: Failure to escalate to 30 mg/day
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant remains on 15 mg/day for the duration of the study due to safety concerns; change from baseline is summarized by dose actually received

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction, interruption, or treatment discontinuation
intercurrentEvents.text: Dose modification or premature discontinuation of ALXN1840; all observed on-treatment change-from-baseline data are included as observed

intercurrentEvents.name: Reinitiation of chelator or zinc therapy
intercurrentEvents.text: Use of prohibited copper-modifying therapy during the study; change from baseline estimated as if such therapy had not been taken

intercurrentEvents.name: Missing or invalid baseline collection
intercurrentEvents.text: Pretreatment baseline collection (Days -4 through -1) not evaluable due to incomplete collection or diet non-adherence; participant excluded from the change-from-baseline analysis as if the event had not occurred

data.treatment: ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day during accumulation and steady-state periods compared with the participant's own pretreatment baseline (Days -4 through -1, off chelator therapy, copper-controlled diet)
data.analysisPopulation: Full Analysis Set (participants with evaluable baseline and at least one post-baseline copper balance assessment); within-participant comparison versus pretreatment baseline
data.variableOfInterest: Change from pretreatment baseline (Days -4 through -1) in mean daily copper balance (copper intake in food and drink minus copper output in feces and urine) during ALXN1840 accumulation and steady-state periods for each dose
data.summaryMeasure: Descriptive summary of within-participant mean change (and percent change) from pretreatment baseline in mean daily copper balance by dose and collection period

data.name: Secondary Estimand - Copper Disposition (Food, Drink, Feces, Urine, Plasma Total Copper and LBC)
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson disease receiving ALXN1840 under controlled dietary conditions in a clinical research unit (Full Analysis Set (all participants who received at least 1 dose of ALXN1840 with evaluable copper disposition samples)) Summary measure: Descriptive summary statistics (mean, SD, median, range) of copper concentrations/amounts by matrix, dose level, and collection period; changes from pretreatment baseline summarized descriptively.

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose modification or non-escalation to 30 mg/day
intercurrentEvents.text: Dose reduction, interruption, or continuation at 15 mg/day instead of escalation; data summarized according to the dose actually received

intercurrentEvents.name: Premature treatment discontinuation
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues ALXN1840 before completing all collection periods; only data collected while on treatment are summarized

intercurrentEvents.name: Incomplete sample collection or diet deviation
intercurrentEvents.text: Incomplete 24-hour urine/fecal collections, duplicate diet sample loss, or deviation from the copper-controlled diet; affected periods excluded and results estimated as if complete collection had occurred

data.treatment: Open-label ALXN1840 15 mg/day followed by 30 mg/day (intra-participant escalation after a minimum of 4 weeks)
data.analysisPopulation: Full Analysis Set (all participants who received at least 1 dose of ALXN1840 with evaluable copper disposition samples)
data.variableOfInterest: Copper quantified in food, drink, feces, and urine, including plasma total copper and labile bound copper (LBC) during ALXN1840 accumulation and steady-state periods for each dose
data.summaryMeasure: Descriptive summary statistics (mean, SD, median, range) of copper concentrations/amounts by matrix, dose level, and collection period; changes from pretreatment baseline summarized descriptively

data.name: Secondary Estimand - Molybdenum Disposition at Steady State
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson disease receiving ALXN1840 at predicted steady state for the 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day doses (Full Analysis Set / Molybdenum Mass Balance Analysis Set (participants with evaluable molybdenum intake and output collections at steady state)) Summary measure: Descriptive summary statistics of molybdenum amounts by matrix and dose level at steady state; percent of administered dose recovered in urine and feces.

intercurrentEvents.name: Steady state not achieved due to dose modification or interruption
intercurrentEvents.text: Dose reduction or interruption prevents attainment of predicted steady state during the collection period; data are analyzed as observed according to actual dosing

intercurrentEvents.name: Treatment discontinuation before steady-state collection
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues ALXN1840 prior to the steady-state molybdenum collection period; only on-treatment data are summarized

intercurrentEvents.name: Incomplete urine/fecal collection
intercurrentEvents.text: Incomplete or lost excreta collections during the mass balance period; the estimate is derived as if complete collection had been obtained (non-evaluable periods excluded)

data.treatment: Open-label ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day at predicted steady state (molybdenum is a surrogate measure of ALXN1840 disposition)
data.analysisPopulation: Full Analysis Set / Molybdenum Mass Balance Analysis Set (participants with evaluable molybdenum intake and output collections at steady state)
data.variableOfInterest: Molybdenum quantified in food, drink, feces, and urine, and plasma total molybdenum at ALXN1840 steady state
data.summaryMeasure: Descriptive summary statistics of molybdenum amounts by matrix and dose level at steady state; percent of administered dose recovered in urine and feces

data.name: Secondary Estimand - Mean Daily Steady-State Molybdenum Balance
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson disease at predicted ALXN1840 steady state for the 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day doses (Molybdenum Mass Balance Analysis Set (participants with evaluable molybdenum intake, dose, and output data)) Summary measure: Descriptive summary statistics of mean daily molybdenum balance by dose level; assessment of neutrality of balance (molybdenum-out equals molybdenum-in) as evidence of steady state.

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose modification, interruption, or non-escalation
intercurrentEvents.text: Dose decrease, interruption, or continuation at 15 mg/day; molybdenum balance summarized by actual dose administered

intercurrentEvents.name: Premature discontinuation of ALXN1840
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues before the steady-state balance collection; only available while-on-treatment balance data are summarized

intercurrentEvents.name: Missed doses / non-compliance with study intervention
intercurrentEvents.text: Missed or non-adherent ALXN1840 dosing alters molybdenum intake; balance estimated as if full compliance had occurred, or intake corrected for doses actually administered

data.treatment: Open-label ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day; molybdenum intake includes food, drink, and ALXN1840 dose
data.analysisPopulation: Molybdenum Mass Balance Analysis Set (participants with evaluable molybdenum intake, dose, and output data)
data.variableOfInterest: Mean daily molybdenum balance, calculated as molybdenum intake (food, drink, and ALXN1840) minus molybdenum output (feces and urine), representing ALXN1840 steady state
data.summaryMeasure: Descriptive summary statistics of mean daily molybdenum balance by dose level; assessment of neutrality of balance (molybdenum-out equals molybdenum-in) as evidence of steady state

data.name: Secondary Estimand - Molybdenum Accumulation
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson disease treated with ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day, in whom potential tissue (eg, hepatic) molybdenum accumulation is of interest (Molybdenum Mass Balance Analysis Set (all treated participants with evaluable molybdenum balance data)) Summary measure: Descriptive summary of net molybdenum balance (mean, SD, range) and number/proportion of participants with net positive balance indicative of accumulation, by dose level.

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose interruption or reduction
intercurrentEvents.text: Dose modification per Table 7 criteria affecting molybdenum input; all data included as observed under actual dosing

intercurrentEvents.name: Treatment discontinuation
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues ALXN1840; accumulation assessed using data collected while on treatment only

intercurrentEvents.name: Dietary molybdate variability / incomplete collections
intercurrentEvents.text: Variation in dietary molybdenum intake or incomplete excreta collection confounding the accumulation assessment; estimate derived as if diet control and complete collection had been maintained

data.treatment: Open-label ALXN1840 15 mg/day followed by 30 mg/day
data.analysisPopulation: Molybdenum Mass Balance Analysis Set (all treated participants with evaluable molybdenum balance data)
data.variableOfInterest: Accumulation of molybdenum as determined by molybdenum balance (net positive molybdenum balance at predicted steady state)
data.summaryMeasure: Descriptive summary of net molybdenum balance (mean, SD, range) and number/proportion of participants with net positive balance indicative of accumulation, by dose level

data.name: Secondary Estimand - Steady-State PK of Total and PUF-Molybdenum
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson disease receiving ALXN1840 with evaluable plasma PK samples at steady state for 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day (Pharmacokinetic (PK) Analysis Set (all participants who received at least 1 dose of ALXN1840 with at least 1 evaluable PK concentration)) Summary measure: Descriptive PK summary statistics by dose level (n, arithmetic and geometric mean, %CV, median, minimum, maximum); dose proportionality assessed descriptively between 15 mg and 30 mg.

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose modification or non-escalation to 30 mg/day
intercurrentEvents.text: Dose reduction, interruption, or remaining on 15 mg/day; PK parameters summarized according to the dose actually administered at the time of sampling

intercurrentEvents.name: Emesis, missed dose, or PK sampling deviation
intercurrentEvents.text: Vomiting after dosing, missed dose, or protocol deviation in PK sample timing/handling rendering profiles non-evaluable; PK estimated as if dosing and sampling had occurred per protocol (non-evaluable profiles excluded)

intercurrentEvents.name: Treatment discontinuation before steady-state PK profile
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues ALXN1840 prior to the steady-state PK assessment; only on-treatment PK data are summarized

data.treatment: Open-label ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day; plasma total molybdenum and plasma ultrafiltrate (PUF) molybdenum as surrogate measures of ALXN1840 exposure
data.analysisPopulation: Pharmacokinetic (PK) Analysis Set (all participants who received at least 1 dose of ALXN1840 with at least 1 evaluable PK concentration)
data.variableOfInterest: Steady-state plasma PK parameters for total molybdenum and PUF-molybdenum (eg, Cmax, tmax, Ctrough, AUCtau, t1/2, CL/F, accumulation ratio)
data.summaryMeasure: Descriptive PK summary statistics by dose level (n, arithmetic and geometric mean, %CV, median, minimum, maximum); dose proportionality assessed descriptively between 15 mg and 30 mg

data.name: Safety Estimand - Safety and Tolerability of Repeat-Dose ALXN1840
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson disease who received at least 1 dose of ALXN1840 (15 mg/day and/or 30 mg/day) (Safety Analysis Set (all participants who received at least 1 dose of ALXN1840)) Summary measure: Descriptive summaries: number and percentage of participants with TEAEs/SAEs by MedDRA system organ class and preferred term, severity and relationship; descriptive statistics and change from baseline for laboratory, ECG, and vital sign parameters; shift tables for clinically significant abnormalities.

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or interruption due to meeting dose modification criteria
intercurrentEvents.text: ALXN1840 dose decreased (down to 15 mg every other day) or interrupted per dose modification criteria; all safety events are attributed to and included under the treatment received

intercurrentEvents.name: Permanent discontinuation of ALXN1840 due to adverse event
intercurrentEvents.text: Discontinuation of study intervention due to a TEAE/SAE is itself captured as a safety outcome and included in the analysis

intercurrentEvents.name: Use of concomitant or rescue medications
intercurrentEvents.text: Use of concomitant medications (including reintroduction of chelator therapy) to manage adverse events; all safety data are included regardless of concomitant medication use

data.treatment: Repeated-dose open-label ALXN1840 15 mg/day for a minimum of 4 weeks followed by 30 mg/day (no comparator arm)
data.analysisPopulation: Safety Analysis Set (all participants who received at least 1 dose of ALXN1840)
data.variableOfInterest: Incidence and severity of TEAEs/SAEs; clinical laboratory assessments (serum chemistry, hematology, coagulation, urinalysis); physical examinations; heart rate and ECG intervals (PR, QRS, QT, QTc) and clinically significant findings from triplicate 12-lead ECG; vital signs (blood pressure and heart rate)
data.summaryMeasure: Descriptive summaries: number and percentage of participants with TEAEs/SAEs by MedDRA system organ class and preferred term, severity and relationship; descriptive statistics and change from baseline for laboratory, ECG, and vital sign parameters; shift tables for clinically significant abnormalities

data.name: Exploratory Estimand - Dose Response of ALXN1840 on Copper Balance
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson disease who received both ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day with evaluable copper balance collections at each dose (Full Analysis Set (within-participant dose comparison; participants with evaluable copper balance at both dose levels)) Summary measure: Descriptive within-participant difference in mean daily copper balance between 30 mg/day and 15 mg/day; graphical/exploratory dose-response characterization.

intercurrentEvents.name: No escalation to 30 mg/day
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant remains on ALXN1840 15 mg/day due to safety concerns and therefore contributes no 30 mg/day data; dose-response estimated among participants who received both doses

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or interruption during a collection period
intercurrentEvents.text: Dose modification during the 15 mg/day or 30 mg/day collection periods; data analyzed as observed according to actual dose received

intercurrentEvents.name: Treatment discontinuation before the 30 mg/day collection period
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues ALXN1840 before the 30 mg/day periods (Days 31-35 and Days 36-39); only available on-treatment data are used

data.treatment: Intra-participant dose comparison of ALXN1840 30 mg/day versus ALXN1840 15 mg/day
data.analysisPopulation: Full Analysis Set (within-participant dose comparison; participants with evaluable copper balance at both dose levels)
data.variableOfInterest: Dose response of ALXN1840 on mean daily copper balance (comparison of copper balance at 30 mg/day versus 15 mg/day)
data.summaryMeasure: Descriptive within-participant difference in mean daily copper balance between 30 mg/day and 15 mg/day; graphical/exploratory dose-response characterization

data.name: Exploratory Estimand - Effect of Treatment Duration on Copper Balance
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson disease with copper balance assessments across multiple collection periods over the first 40 days of ALXN1840 treatment (Full Analysis Set (all treated participants with at least two evaluable copper balance collection periods)) Summary measure: Descriptive summary of mean daily copper balance by collection period over time, with within-participant differences between accumulation and steady-state periods.

intercurrentEvents.name: Extension of the Outpatient Period
intercurrentEvents.text: Outpatient Period (Day 9 to Day 23) extended by up to 14 additional days, or check-in on Day 22 instead of Day 23, altering the nominal timing of collection periods; actual elapsed treatment duration is used in the time-course analysis

intercurrentEvents.name: Non-adherence to copper-controlled diet during Outpatient Period
intercurrentEvents.text: Participants are encouraged but not required to remain on a copper-controlled diet while outpatient; a diet equilibration period is included in each study period, and the time effect is estimated as if diet control had been maintained

intercurrentEvents.name: Premature discontinuation of ALXN1840
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues study intervention before later collection periods; only observed on-treatment periods contribute to the time-course assessment

data.treatment: Repeat-dose ALXN1840 (15 mg/day at the beginning and end of the 15 mg/day treatment period; 30 mg/day at accumulation and steady state), comparing early versus later collection periods
data.analysisPopulation: Full Analysis Set (all treated participants with at least two evaluable copper balance collection periods)
data.variableOfInterest: Effect of time following initiation of ALXN1840 treatment on mean daily copper balance (accumulation versus steady-state collection periods)
data.summaryMeasure: Descriptive summary of mean daily copper balance by collection period over time, with within-participant differences between accumulation and steady-state periods

data.name: Exploratory Estimand - Ceruloplasmin, Ceruloplasmin-Bound Copper, and LBC
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson disease treated with ALXN1840 with evaluable plasma copper speciation samples (Full Analysis Set (all treated participants with baseline/predose and at least one post-dose ceruloplasmin or copper speciation assessment)) Summary measure: Descriptive summary statistics of absolute values and change from predose in ceruloplasmin, ceruloplasmin-bound copper, and LBC by nominal visit and dose level.

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose modification or non-escalation to 30 mg/day
intercurrentEvents.text: Dose reduction, interruption, or continuation at 15 mg/day; biomarker results summarized by actual dose received at the time of sampling

intercurrentEvents.name: Reinitiation of chelator or zinc therapy
intercurrentEvents.text: Use of prohibited copper-modifying background/rescue therapy confounding plasma copper speciation; results estimated as if such therapy had not been used

intercurrentEvents.name: Treatment discontinuation or missed biomarker sampling
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues ALXN1840 or misses scheduled Day 1/8/25/29/36/39 sampling; only available on-treatment assessments are summarized with no imputation

data.treatment: Open-label ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day compared with predose (baseline) values
data.analysisPopulation: Full Analysis Set (all treated participants with baseline/predose and at least one post-dose ceruloplasmin or copper speciation assessment)
data.variableOfInterest: Ceruloplasmin, ceruloplasmin-bound copper, and labile bound copper (LBC) profiles; change in ceruloplasmin at Days 1, 8, 25, 29, 36, and 39 compared with predose
data.summaryMeasure: Descriptive summary statistics of absolute values and change from predose in ceruloplasmin, ceruloplasmin-bound copper, and LBC by nominal visit and dose level
